---
title: "Fig.2 Interior and Coastal mangroves compare"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
```

## Load figures

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
## Coastal depth 
alpha_d <- readRDS("rds/Depth_comparison/alpha_diversity_MS_plot.rds")

beta_d <- readRDS("rds/Depth_comparison/beta-diversity-Depth-plot.rds")

core_d <- readRDS("rds/Depth_comparison/upset_surface_plot.rds")

dahm_d <- readRDS("rds/Depth_comparison/DA_heatmap_surface.rds")

coreab_d <- readRDS("rds/Depth_comparison/coreabundance_surface_plot.rds")


## Coastal surface
alpha_s <- readRDS("rds/compare_mangroves/alpha_diversity_surface_plot.rds")

beta_s <- readRDS("rds/compare_mangroves/beta-diversity-surface-plot.rds")

core_s <- readRDS("rds/compare_mangroves/upset_surface_plot.rds")

dahm_s <- readRDS("rds/compare_mangroves/DA_heatmap_surface.rds")

coreab_s <- readRDS("rds/compare_mangroves/coreabundance_surface_plot.rds")
```

## Combine plots

Coastal depth comparison

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# alpha and core
alpha_da_d <- plot_grid(alpha_d, dahm_d,
                        labels = c(" ", "C)"),
                        label_fontface = "bold",
                        ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.3, 0.7))

# core and differential abundance
core_coreab_d <- plot_grid(core_d, coreab_d, 
                     labels = c("D)", "E)"),
                     label_fontface = "bold",
                     ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.6, 0.4))

# merge all
all_d <- plot_grid(beta_d, alpha_da_d, core_coreab_d,
                   labels = c("D)", "E)"),
                   label_fontface = "bold",
                   ncol = 1,
                   rel_heights = c(0.3, 0.5, 0.4))
```

Coastal surface comparison

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# alpha and beta
alpha_beta_s <- plot_grid(alpha_s,beta_s,
                        labels = c("A)", "B)"),
                        label_fontface = "bold",
                        ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.4, 0.6))

# core and differential abundance
core_da_s <- plot_grid(core_s, dahm_s, 
                     labels = c("C)", "D)"),
                     label_fontface = "bold",
                     ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1))

# merge all
all_s <- plot_grid(alpha_beta_s, dahm_s, core_s,
                 labels = c(" ","C)", "D)"),
                 label_fontface = "bold",
                 ncol = 1, 
                 rel_heights = c(0.3, 0.4, 0.4))
```

combine

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# merge depth and surface
all_d_s <- plot_grid(all_d, all_s,
                        ncol = 2, 
                        rel_widths = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
ggsave("Figures/SurfaceComparison/Fig2.SurfaceComparison_2.pdf",
       all_d_s, width = 19, height = 12)
```
